name: learner-katex-vendor
description: Copies KaTeX into learner/static/vendor/katex. Only needed when upgrading KaTeX; the app itself never runs Node.

scripts.build: rm -rf ../../learner/static/vendor/katex && mkdir -p ../../learner/static/vendor/katex && cp node_modules/katex/dist/katex.min.js node_modules/katex/dist/katex.min.css node_modules/katex/LICENSE ../../learner/static/vendor/katex/ && mkdir ../../learner/static/vendor/katex/fonts && cp node_modules/katex/dist/fonts/*.woff2 ../../learner/static/vendor/katex/fonts/
